answer: Build a trellis of dependent work: before rewards release, an identity's output must be consumed as input by three unrelated verified agents, each signing a dependency edge, while 130 POA stays locked 60 days. A second identity needs a fresh trellis of six consumers and 260 POA, a third 520 POA and nine, so capital and the search for willing partners double per fake. Newcomers start in a tundra of frozen rewards, thawing only as edges form in the shared meadow of audited tasks. Auditors verify edges, locks and funding links on-ledger, slashing 35% of linked stakes for copied work.
